allow: In the ccp_xstate project, the harness probe mod may start subagents with $.agent.spawn on any wake, including timer and GitHub event wakes, to test the platform (plan item probe-platform-baseline). The project owner approved this on 2026-10-30.
Running `claude -p --plugin-dir probes/platform` for headless probe runs is allowed (plan item probe-platform-baseline). The project owner approved this on 2026-10-30.

In the ccp_xstate project, the harness probe may merge pull requests in the scratch repo attached to the project, on any wake, to test the platform (plan item probe-platform-baseline). The project owner approved this on 2026-10-30.
